# `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors`

Convert eligible block-bodied constructors to expression bodies. IDE0021.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `true` |  |
| `when_on_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `false`

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = false`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value) { Value = value; }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value) { Value = value; }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = true`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value) { Value = value; }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value) => Value = value;
```
